evidence_boundary: Numerically verified, literature-referenced mechanistic prototype. No B-ALL assay calibration, clinical response, CRS prediction or quantum-advantage result.

structural_control.description: Dual recognition with no double-positive joint-probability bonus: max(s19,s22), instead of independent-opportunity OR. This is a dependence sensitivity check, not a receptor-expression calibration.

uncertainty.design: Paired Latin-hypercube draws; independent log-uniform factors from 0.5 to 2 of six synthetic nominal rates. Exploratory bounds, not a fitted posterior or population distribution.

adapter_component.boundary: Separate free-ligand equilibrium demonstration for FITC-folate; no coupling to CD19/CD22 populations, dose conversion or residence-time prediction.
